name: prompt-rag-query-design
description: Use when the user asks about query rewriting, HyDE, multi-query retrieval, query decomposition, multi-hop RAG, step-back prompting, GraphRAG or a grounded RAG prompt that cites sources and abstains. Produces the LLM-side RAG pipeline: query transforms, routing and the answer prompt. Not for ANN indexes, hybrid fusion and reranking (use llm-rag-retrieval-internals).
